title: Choose services only when needed
summary: Microservices bring independent releases and scaling, but add network calls and more operations work. Compare those costs before splitting an app.
introduction: Microservices bring independent releases and scaling, but add network calls and more operations work. Compare those costs before splitting an app. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain choose services only when needed
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Microservices bring independent releases and scaling, but add network calls and more operations work. Compare those costs before splitting an app.

blocks.code:
Small team, one release schedule -> one well-organised app
Many teams, different scaling needs -> consider service boundaries
blocks.title: Choose services only when needed

blocks.text: Both choices can be good. The team and problem decide; a fashionable name does not.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
List one benefit and one cost of separating search from loans.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not turn a static tutorial website into a backend project just to practise architecture.
For more detail later, use this [Microservices further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/microservices/).
